# Calibration services: personnel schedule

⟦ORG|Copper Kite Metrology LLP⟧ appoints the following individuals to check the pressure instruments listed in the equipment annex. This schedule forms part of the services agreement dated 11 October 2026. The appointment concerns competence and access only; it does not transfer ownership of the instruments or create an employment relationship with the Customer.

| Function | Given name | Family name | Authority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Lead technician | ⟦PERSON|Eryx⟧ | ⟦PERSON|Nolliver⟧ | Release test results |
| Substitute | ⟦PERSON|Tavia⟧ | ⟦PERSON|Zelm⟧ | Witness pressure checks |

The technician named in the first row must attend the initial inspection. The substitute may attend later visits after written notice. A change of personnel requires evidence of equivalent training, although the Customer must not withhold approval merely because a replacement has less experience with this particular site.

**Lead technician's passport No:** ⟦IDENTITY|BZ-7O4?21⟧. The damaged characters are copied from the visitor log and will be checked against the passport at reception. That check must occur before access is granted, rather than being treated as an acceptance of the instrument readings.

Testing will use three increasing loads followed by a descending series. Results outside the agreed tolerance must be reported separately from recommendations for repair. The service fee is EUR 1,280; section 8.4 governs retesting costs.

Approved by lead technician, initials: ⟦PERSON|E. N.⟧.
